after.rosterkit/contacts.py:
# owner: platform
"""Contact sheet rows for substitute teachers."""

from typing import Iterable, List

from rosterkit.models import Student

def _cells(student: Student) -> List[str]:
    name = student.display_name
    if not student.email:
        raise ValueError(f"no email: {name}")
    return [name, student.section, student.email]

def _join(row: List[str], widths: List[int]) -> str:
    pairs = zip(row, widths)
    cells = [text.ljust(size) for text, size in pairs]
    return "  ".join(cells).rstrip()

def contact_rows(students: Iterable[Student]) -> List[str]:
    """Rows sorted by name with the columns lined up."""
    cells = sorted(_cells(item) for item in students)
    if not cells:
        raise ValueError("no students")
    columns = zip(*cells)
    widths = [max(map(len, column)) for column in columns]
    return [_join(row, widths) for row in cells]
